title: Vestiaire merchant lead discovery
description: Discover Vestiaire sellers from public search/category listings, enrich public seller statistics, and output one merchant lead per seller.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Brands, categories, or product phrases used to discover sellers.

startUrls.title: Filtered Vestiaire URLs
startUrls.description: Optional public Vestiaire search, brand, or category URLs. Existing URL filters are preserved.

country.title: Market
country.description: Vestiaire market used for search URLs and localized prices.

sellerCountries.title: Seller countries
sellerCountries.description: Optional ISO country-code filter applied through Vestiaire's public Shipped From listing filter and verified again from seller detail. United Kingdom is canonicalized to GB; UK is accepted as an input alias. Leave empty for all seller countries.

maxListingsPerQuery.title: Maximum listings per source
maxListingsPerQuery.description: Maximum listing cards sampled from each query or start URL.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Maximum pages per source
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Hard pagination cap for every discovery source.

maxSellers.title: Maximum qualified sellers to output
maxSellers.description: Maximum qualified merchant leads written to the Dataset after seller-detail filters are applied.

maxSellerDetailCandidates.title: Maximum seller detail candidates
maxSellerDetailCandidates.description: Maximum unique sellers whose public detail pages are inspected before country and qualification filters. Increase this when filtering to a specific seller country.

minItemsSold.title: Minimum public items sold
minItemsSold.description: Only output sellers whose public products_sold statistic meets this threshold.

minItemsListed.title: Minimum public items listed
minItemsListed.description: Only output sellers whose public products_listed statistic meets this threshold.

allowedSellerSegments.title: Allowed seller segments
allowedSellerSegments.description: Filter by Vestiaire public seller segment. Keep UNKNOWN to retain sellers without a published segment.

requireSellerDetails.title: Require seller statistics
requireSellerDetails.description: Exclude sellers when a representative product detail cannot provide public seller statistics.

refreshProfileStats.title: Refresh sold/listed counts from profile
refreshProfileStats.description: After parsing product-detail statistics, visit the numeric Seller Profile in the same browser session and override sold/listed counts from the current profile header when available.

maxRequestRetries.title: Maximum retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Maximum retries for a blocked or failed page.

navigationTimeoutSecs.title: Page timeout
navigationTimeoutSecs.description: Seconds to wait for search responses and seller detail data.

autoMarketProxy.title: Use a proxy matched to the selected market
autoMarketProxy.description: Uses the Apify Residential Proxy with the selected market's country for the browser session. Turn off only when custom proxy URLs already provide the correct market location.

dedupeMode.title: Cross-run deduplication mode
dedupeMode.description: Control whether all, only new, or new and updated sellers are emitted.

dedupeStoreName.title: Persistent state store
dedupeStoreName.description: Named key-value store shared across runs. Use a separate name per campaign.

reemitAfterDays.title: Re-emit unchanged leads after days
reemitAfterDays.description: Set to 0 to never periodically re-emit unchanged sellers.

contactEnrichment.title: Enrich public business contacts
contactEnrichment.description: Discover likely official websites and extract public business contact links.
contactEnrichment.sectionDescription: Starts a paid Google Search Actor run for eligible leads. Personal-lead enrichment remains disabled.

maxContactEnrichmentLeads.title: Maximum leads to enrich
maxContactEnrichmentLeads.description: Maximum highest-scoring uncached leads searched per run.

minLeadScoreForEnrichment.title: Minimum lead score for contacts
minLeadScoreForEnrichment.description: Only leads at or above this score are considered for public website discovery.

minContactConfidence.title: Verified contact confidence
minContactConfidence.description: Minimum evidence score for a verified official website and contacts.

contactCacheDays.title: Contact cache duration
contactCacheDays.description: Reuse public contact evidence for this many days.

contactSearchActorId.title: Website search Actor
contactSearchActorId.description: Compatible Google organic-result Actor used for official website discovery.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional custom Apify proxy settings. When automatic market proxy is enabled, the selected market country and Residential group are used unless overridden here. Residential proxy adds transfer cost.
